item.title: Weird laptop keyboard
item.author: julio@meroh.net (Julio Merino)
item.description: My aunt asked me if I’d do a full reinstall of the software in her laptop, a Compaq Presario 1200, because it was not working properly. This was horrible to do due to the speed of the machine, which feels incredibly slow nowadays.
